examples.en: Soft water is kinder to your hair.
examples.zh: 软性水质不易损伤头发。

examples.en: Cohen was making an effort to present a kinder, gentler image.
examples.zh: 科恩在努力表现出一副更和善、更温柔的形象。

examples.en: Backpackers are also kinder to the environment, because they use trains and buses rather than cars.
examples.zh: 背包客对环境也更友好，因为他们乘坐火车和公共汽车而不是汽车。
